note: Checked specs for particular vehicles, shown to customers as 'Recommended for your car' and used to pre-select the drop-downs. Only add values you've checked against the owner's manual, a parts catalogue or the tyre placard: wrong oil or brake parts are a safety risk. Matching works like vehicle_classes.json: make (aliases apply), model prefix, optional year range. Example entry (not real data, shape only): {"make": "toyota", "model": "corolla", "years": [2019, 2025], "oil_grade": "0W-20", "oil_litres": 4.2, "tyre_sizes": ["205/55R16"], "notes": "Checked against owner's manual"}
